description: This file defines the 'MenuScreen' widget for a Flutter mobile app. It builds a UI with a tabbed menu containing categorized items, each with images, ingredients, spice levels, portio options, and an add-to-cart button. It interacts with 'MenuProvider' for fetching data and 'CartProvider' for cart actions.

classes.name: MenuScreen
classes.description: A stateless widget that displays a categorized tabbed menu with items, images, spice levels, portions, and add-to-cart functionality.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the menu screen, including tabs for categories, item listings, and a floating cart button.
